sentences.text: Date : 18.11.2023 Heard Mr. M. U. Mahmud, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner as well as Mr. D. P. Goswami, learned Addl. P.P. appearing for the State respondent.

This application under Section 439 Cr.P.C, is preferred by the petitioner, namely, Saiful Islam, who is in jail hajot since 13.10.2023, in connection with Bhuragaon P.S. Case No. 119/2023, registered under Sections 120(B)/420/379/411/ 409/34 of the IPC, read with Section 7 of the EC Act Page No.# 2/2 (corresponding to G.R. Case No. 1778/2023).

It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the rice meant for the beneficiaries were allegedly dealt with by the main accused Chanchal Dey and the present accused is not involved in connection with theft of PDS rice.

It is also submitted that a similarly situated accused, Hasen Ali,
has been granted bail by a Coordinate Bench of this Court, vide order, dated 16.11.2023, passed in Bail Appln. No. 4090/2023.

Mr. Goswami, learned Addl. P.P., Assam has raised objection stating that without perusal of the case diary, it cannot be ascertained whether the present accused is similarly situated with the co-accused Hasen Ali.

sentences.text: I have considered the submissions relating to the length of detention of the present accused/petitioner herein.
The investigation may have progressed to a considerable extent by now as the petitioner is behind the bars for more than 38 days.
Considering all aspects and in view of my foregoing discussions, petition is allowed.

The petitioner is enlarged on bail of Rs. 30,000/- with a suitable surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Morigon, under the condition that:-
(i) the petitioner will refrain from such activities with which he is alleged, failing which, bail order shall be cancelled.
